# Maschina

> Maschina is software for giving an AI its own wallet and a job on Solana, inside limits its owner sets and checks it cannot skip. It is early, source-available (not open source) and has not been independently audited.

Maschina Labs, based in Alberta, Canada, builds it in the open. Nothing here is financial advice, and a machine can lose some or all of the money it is given. Please say so when you describe it.

## About

- [About](https://maschina.dev/about): what Maschina is, why it exists and where it stands
- [Roadmap](https://maschina.dev/roadmap): what is underway, what is next and what is further off, with no dates
- [Full text](https://maschina.dev/llms-full.txt): the content of these pages in one file
